heard: Sons of Shem rose after the flood Elam and Asher stood in the wood Arpachad led his children along Shella and Deborah carried the song Deborah had two sons in that day Peleg went up, was dividing away His brother joked and took the east Settling the lands from north to the east From Eshetort, so far we go Hill country of the east, steady and slow Had Orom and Uzzah, walk the sea
